claim.claim-text: 1. A system for a driving related measurement, comprising:
a connector located towards a rear region of a vehicle; and a measurement apparatus assembly that is accessible through a hole in the connector, wherein the measurement apparatus assembly includes:

a housing comprising a first surface located towards a top region of the housing, a second surface located towards a bottom region of the housing, and a side surface extending between the first surface and the second surface, wherein the first surface and the second surface extend at least up to a perimeter of the side surface on the top region and the bottom region, respectively; a measurement device located in the housing and comprising a rotatable shaft that extends towards a first hole in the first surface, wherein a top of the rotatable shaft is coupled to one or more magnets that are located above the first hole in the first surface, and wherein the measurement device is configured to provide an electrical signal that indicates an angle corresponding to an extent of a rotational movement of the rotatable shaft; and
a cable connected to the measurement device, wherein the measurement device and at least some portion of the cable is movable towards the first surface of the housing.

2. The system of claim 1, wherein the connector includes a groove that extends inward from an edge of the connector towards a center region of the connector and/or the connector includes a fifth wheel.

3. The system of claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising: a trailer located towards a rear of the vehicle, wherein the trailer is coupled to the connector of the vehicle via a second connector of the trailer, wherein the second connector is magnetically coupled to a top of the one or more magnets that are coupled to the rotatable shaft, wherein a number of the one or more magnets is optionally adjustable to cause the top of the one or more magnets to magnetically couple to the second connector.

4. The system of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the measurement apparatus assembly is located in or below the hole of the connector and/or coupled to a surface below the connector of the vehicle.

5. The system of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the measurement device is configured to provide another electrical signal that indicates an orientation corresponding to a direction of the rotational movement of the rotatable shaft.
6. The system of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the second surface includes a second hole that includes a portion of the cable that is connected to the measurement device.
7. The system of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the cable is connected to a bottom of the measurement device that faces towards the second surface of the housing.
8. A measurement apparatus assembly, comprising:

a housing comprising a first surface located towards a top region of the housing, a second surface located towards a bottom region of the housing, and a side surface extending between the first surface and the second surface, wherein the first surface and the second surface extend at least up to a perimeter of the side surface on the top region and the bottom region, respectively; and a measurement device located in the housing and comprising a rotatable shaft that extends towards a first hole in the first surface,

wherein a top of the rotatable shaft is coupled to one or more magnets that are located above the first hole in the first surface, and wherein the measurement device is configured to provide an electrical signal that indicates an angle corresponding to an extent of a rotational movement of the rotatable shaft, wherein the measurement device is movable towards the first surface of the housing.
9. The measurement apparatus assembly of claim 8, wherein the measurement device is movable towards the first surface of the housing via a plurality of compressible springs.

10. The measurement apparatus assembly of claim 9, wherein the plurality of compressible springs are located in between the measurement device and a bottom of the first surface of the housing that faces the measurement device.

11. The measurement apparatus assembly of claim 10, wherein the plurality of compressible springs in a compressed position cause the measurement device to move towards the first surface of the housing and/or wherein the plurality of compressible springs in an extended position cause the measurement device to move away from the first surface of the housing.

12. The measurement apparatus assembly of claim 9, wherein the measurement device is movably coupled to the first surface of the housing via a plurality of screws, and wherein each screw optionally includes a smooth region located in a compressible spring from the plurality of compressible springs.
13. The measurement apparatus assembly of any one of claims 8 to 12, wherein the first surface is coupled to the side surface of the housing towards the top region of the housing.
14. The measurement apparatus assembly of any one of claims 8 to 13, wherein the first surface, the second surface, and the side surface of the housing comprise a non-magnetic metal.
15. The measurement apparatus assembly of any one of claims 8 to 14, wherein at least some portion of the rotatable shaft protrudes from the first hole in the first surface of the housing.
